showcase.title: Platform features
showcase.subtitle: A complete hospital information system — showcased on entirely synthetic data.
showcase.intro: SantéGrid covers the full hospital journey, from patient reception to regional oversight. The previews below are illustrative and synthetic: no real patient data is shown, and no record-writing action is available without authentication.

modules.patientBody: Patient identity, visit opening, consultation and clinical documentation; warning-only duplicate detection (no automatic merge).
modules.billingBody: Invoicing, multi-mode payment, printable receipts, cashier controls, and dual-validated cancellations and refunds.
modules.pharmacyBody: Medication catalogue, batch stock, FEFO reservation, dispensing, dual-validated stock adjustments and pharmacy reports.
modules.labBody: Exam requests, result entry and separate validation (the requester is not the validator), with a result-visibility gate.
modules.emergencyBody: "Treat first, pay later" handling with an emergency debt coupled to the action, settleable or waivable (Director).
modules.hospitalizationBody: Ward admission, daily charges, and discharge gated on settled invoices and emergency debts.
modules.reportingBody: Aggregate operational reports and a DHIS2-aligned CSV export — strictly aggregate, with no patient identifiers.
modules.insuranceBody: Foundations for third-party payer coverage: payers, coverage and draft reimbursement claims.
modules.matchingBody: Warning-only duplicate matching, a mock MPI adapter (no network, no automatic merge).
modules.securityBody: Server-side role-based access control, per-hospital separation, and a timestamped audit trail of every action.
modules.networkBody: Multi-hospital configuration and aggregate-only regional oversight — with no patient-level access at the central level.

proof.title: Verified online review environment
proof.subtitle: For partners, banks and non-technical reviewers: this application exists, is deployed online and rests on a verified foundation — without exposing source code or architecture.
proof.testsBody: Unit, integration and end-to-end tests run on every change.
proof.guardrailsBody: Automated guardrails: layer separation, no secrets, no real data.
proof.financialBody: Atomic payments and account lockout after failures, proven by concurrency tests.
proof.auditBody: Every action is logged; role-based access and per-hospital separation enforced server-side.
